import sys
width=900
height=420
use_pil=True
try:
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
except Exception as e:
    use_pil=False
    print("PIL not available, will write a simple PPM fallback")
    # create PPM fallback
    w=width; h=height; img=['P3',f"{w} {h}","255"]
    # simple gradient background and a few shapes
    for y in range(h):
        row=[]
        for x in range(w):
            r=int(40+((x%100)/100)*80)
            g=int(60+((y%100)/100)*150)
            b=int(120+((x+y)%70))%256
            row.append(f"{r} {g} {b}")
        img.append(' '.join(row))
    with open('assets/screenshot-settings-cassette.ppm','w') as f:
        f.write('
'.join(img))
    print('Wrote assets/screenshot-settings-cassette.ppm')
    sys.exit(0)

# If PIL is available, draw with more polish
im=Image.new('RGB',(width,height),'#f7f7f7')
d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
# background panels
d.rectangle([20,60,880,360], fill=(250,250,250), outline=None)
d.rectangle([30,70,150,100], fill=(200,200,255))
d.rectangle([170,70,350,100], fill=(200,255,200))
d.rectangle([360,70,520,100], fill=(255,214,128))
d.rectangle([540,70,820,100], fill=(200,230,255))
# titles
try:
    fnt=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 22)
except Exception:
    fnt=None
d.text((40,40),'Settings', fill=(0,0,0), font=fnt)
d.text((60,90),'Panel: DISPLAY', fill=(0,0,0), font=fnt)
d.text((60,70),'Screen: Cassette', fill=(0,0,0), font=fnt)
d.text((60,110),'Variant: v2', fill=(0,0,0), font=fnt)
# cassette region mock
d.text((60,150),'Cassette variant controls appear below screen when Cassette is selected', fill=(0,0,0), font=fnt)
im.save('assets/screenshot-settings-cassette.png')
print('Wrote assets/screenshot-settings-cassette.png')
